messages:
kate: Quick follow-up: we need a crisp migration plan to converge credential formats across gateway and sidecars. Goal: one canonical parse and minimal trust in client hints. cc @raj @maria

raj: Proposal: introduce header `X-RW-Auth: kind=<kind>;token=<token>;meta=<json-b64>` where kind in (api_key,ephemeral,svc). meta is optional telemetry only. Runtime will always resolve token->actor via identity service.

maria: Important: do not map permissions from client-provided meta. Always derive roles from actor. Also require origin tag in audit events (legacy|unified).

kate: Rollout idea: accept both legacy Authorization and X-RW-Auth for 100 days, emit deprecation logs and console banners for stale keys, then phase to enforcement at 200 days. Dedicated/private can request extensions.

raj: Implementation notes: parse at gateway, attach normalized claim bag to request context, cache token->claims with default TTL 3m. Cache override per-route to 30s for sensitive routes. Avoid crypto per-request; use a small LRU.

maria: Tests: parsing unit tests, fuzz unknown header shapes, authz mapping regression tests, e2e on private deploy with KMS. Also add a migration linter to flag services still sending Authorization.

kate: Edgecases: proxies that strip headers, signed webhook schemes tied to raw auth, query-param keys. Plan: sidecar nginx + Envoy snippets, and migration docs for webhook signing.

infra-bot: feature flag created: auth.unified_header_enabled (off by default).

raj: Rollout steps: 1) accept header silently, 2) enable in staging canary 1w, 3) opt-in Dedicated, 4) enable for low-traffic hosted routes, 5) show deprecation telemetry, 6) enforce after window. Rollback if auth failures >0.5% for 10m.

maria: Owners: raj->gateway parsing, kate->docs+console banners, maria->authz tests+linter.

kate: I'll draft the playbook and migration snippets and post link here. :thumbsup:
